dslRule:
<!id: messagedialog.openquestion.to.open>
<!description: Replace MessageDialog.openQuestion with MessageDialog.open using custom button labels for clarity.>
<!severity: INFO>
org.eclipse.jface.dialogs.MessageDialog.openQuestion($shell, $title, $msg)
=>
org.eclipse.jface.dialogs.MessageDialog.open(org.eclipse.jface.dialogs.MessageDialog.QUESTION, $shell, $title, $msg, org.eclipse.swt.SWT.NONE, new java.lang.String[] { org.eclipse.ui.texteditor.EditorMessages.Editor_error_replace_button_label, org.eclipse.ui.texteditor.EditorMessages.Editor_error_dontreplace_button_label })
;;
